short_description: The uniGradICON network's prediction, then 50 steps of instance optimisation on LNCC: unigradicon-register with its defaults, the ImagingBenchmarks baseline unigradicon.
description:
The uniGradICON network's prediction, then 50 steps of instance optimisation on LNCC: unigradicon-register with its defaults, the ImagingBenchmarks baseline unigradicon. The pair must be aligned (rigidly for one patient, by an affine transform between two subjects): only the deformable stage runs. The command knows two modalities, ct (clamped to [-1000, 1000] HU) and mri (minimum to the 99th percentile), read off the intensities. The weights come from the authors' release, checked against their hash; the package is pinned at 1.0.5. A GPU is needed. Output: the displacement field on the fixed grid, in mm along the world axes (ITK, LPS).

How to cite:
L. Tian et al., uniGradICON: A foundation model for medical image registration, MICCAI 2024; B. Demir et al., multiGradICON, WBIR 2024.
